name: ProtonVPN Accessibility
author: Mama Sene
description: Improves accessibility of the ProtonVPN Windows application for NVDA users. Main features: - Proper labeling of buttons and controls - Dynamic announcements for VPN status information - Announcements for IP address, country, provider and traffic - Keyboard shortcuts for quick actions - French and English documentation This is a community add-on and is not affiliated with Proton AG.
